top_signals.title: Big Tech Turns to Fuel Cells to Power the AI Boom
top_signals.summary: Tech giants are tapping fuel cell developers and providers to power data and AI computing centers with technology that is cleaner and faster to implement than a conventional gas-powered electricity source. Fuel cells generate electricity by directly converting chemical energy into electrical energy without combustion. This technology can run on a variety of fuels, including hydrogen, natural gas, and biogas.
